P.name: Hextech Munitions
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Corki's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} deal {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}}} equal to {{as|20% AD}}. This damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
P.description2: {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} {{nie|Wind's Fury}} bolts and all {{tip|Spellblade}} effects are special cased to benefit from ''Hextech Munitions'', causing them to deal {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}} equal to 20% of their {{tt|pre-mitigation damage|Damage calculated before modifiers}}.

Q.name: Phosphorus Bomb
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Corki''' launches a bomb at the target location that briefly grants {{tip|sight}} of its {{tt|surroundings|Cannot grant sight through terrain and can only grant sight into brush when the missile flies through that brush}} as it travels and explodes upon impact, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
Q.description2: The bomb also grants {{tip|sight}} of the impact area for 6 seconds and {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} enemy {{tip|champions}} hit for the same duration.

W.name: Valkyrie
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Corki''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target location and drops bombs that leave up to 3 blazing patches along his path, depending on the distance traveled. Each patch lasts {{fd|2.5}} seconds.
W.description2: Enemies within the patches are dealt {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds, lingering for 1 second.
W.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|30 to 90}} {{as|(+ 40% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|30*5 to 90*5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*5}}% AP)}}}}
W.description3: ''{{ai|Gatling Gun|Corki}} can be cast during the dash.''

E.name: Gatling Gun
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Corki''' sprays bullets in a cone toward his facing direction for 4 seconds, dealing {{as|physical damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds to all enemies hit and applying a {{tip|stack}} to them at the same tick rate for 2 seconds, refreshing with subsequent hits and stacking up to 4 times. Each stack reduces the target's {{sti|lethality|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance}}}}.
E.leveling:
{{st|Physical Damage Per Tick|{{ap|80/16 to 280/16}} {{as|(+ {{ap|240/16}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|80 to 280}} {{as|(+ 240% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Resistances Reduction Per Stack|{{ap|3 to 5}}|Total Resistances Reduction|{{ap|3*4 to 5*4}}}}

R.name: Missile Barrage
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{tip|Basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} against champions reduce ''Missile Barrage's'' remaining recharge time by {{pp|2 to 6 for 11|0 to 100|type=critical strike chance|color=critical chance|key1=%}} seconds.
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Corki''' fires a missile in the target direction that explodes upon the first enemy hit, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies within the area.
R.description3: '''Corki''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Missile Barrage'' charge, up to a maximum of 4. He gains 2 charges upon learning the ability and maximum charges upon [[death|respawning]].
R.description4: Every third missile '''Corki''' fires is a ''{{ai|Big One|Corki}}'', dealing 100% increased damage as well as gaining increased range and explosion radius.
